title.value: Run slow background reports and research on a Mac mini

introduction.value: OpenClaw on a Mac mini handles sales reports, inventory checks, and roughly 30-minute research tasks in the background, alongside Cowork.

method.value: The author runs OpenClaw on a headless Mac mini, set to skip FileVault, auto-login and never sleep. It is paired with a Telegram bot and has skills such as Peekaboo for computer control, PDF and Session logs. It pulls Stripe, App Store and Amazon sales data and scans Shopify inventory. Cowork handles on-demand tasks. He checks in remotely with Workbench.

outcome.value: He says tasks that used to wait a week because they tied up his laptop for hours now run overnight. Agents do stall on login screens or permission dialogs until he steps in.

notes.value: Budget roughly $20 to $80 a month in API spend for moderate use. Overnight runs need remote check-ins to clear stalled dialogs.

source_text.body:
Run slow background reports and research on a Mac mini
OpenClaw on a Mac mini handles sales reports, inventory checks, and roughly 30-minute research tasks in the background, alongside Cowork.
Done with
OC
OpenClaw
CW
Claude Cowork
What they did
The author runs OpenClaw on a headless Mac mini, set to skip FileVault, auto-login and never sleep. It is paired with a Telegram bot and has skills such as Peekaboo for computer control, PDF and Session logs. It pulls Stripe, App Store and Amazon sales data and scans Shopify inventory. Cowork handles on-demand tasks. He checks in remotely with Workbench.
How it went
He says tasks that used to wait a week because they tied up his laptop for hours now run overnight. Agents do stall on login screens or permission dialogs until he steps in.
Worth knowing
Budget roughly $20 to $80 a month in API spend for moderate use. Overnight runs need remote check-ins to clear stalled dialogs.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
Handle these slow background jobs for me: [weekly sales report from source], [inventory check against threshold or supplier list], and research on [topic] that may take about 30 minutes. For each one, save the finished result as a short document in [folder] and message me when it is ready with the three most important findings. Do not send anything to other people or change any data in my systems without showing me first.
Original source: https://astropad.com/blog/openclaw-mac-mini/
